newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ERICSSON KEEPS HELPING SWEDISH SHARES UP.
newsitem.headline: ERICSSON KEEPS HELPING SWEDISH SHARES UP.

text.p: Swedish shares opened higher on Thursday, fuelled by Wall Street's day-earlier gains and continued advances in telecoms group Ericsson.
The Stockholm bourse's general index rose 0.89 percent to 3,254.85 in turnover of 420 million crowns.
"Heavyweights will probably pull the market higher and export companies could keep benefiting from the stronger dollar," said a trader, looking ahead.
Ericsson rose five crowns to 374 after surging 13.5 crowns in Stockholm a day earlier and closing even higher, at about 372 crowns, in New York.
Investment company Investor advanced four crowns to 429 after releasing six-month earnings.

The Swedish parent company of international engineer ABB rose 1.5 crowns to 112 ahead of ABB presenting six-month figures. Market expectations are for a 4.5 percent growth in first-half group net profit to 581 million.
Automotive group Volvo gained 4.5 crowns to 226.5 on the back of a stronger dollar.
Drugs major Astra edged one crown higher to 153 after closing higher in New York than in Stockholm a day earlier. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1006
